name: libreta-de-nominas
description: Libreta de Nóminas — registro digital de adelantos, consumos y descuentos de empleados.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --parallel -r --filter=./apps/* run dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter api run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --filter=./apps/* run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r run test
